kind_of_thing.quote: The tambourine is a musical instrument in the percussion family consisting of a frame, often of wood or plastic, with pairs of small metal jingles, called "zills".

kind_of_made_thing.why: It is a small hand-held percussion instrument that children play and shake, so a parent would call it a toy.

how_we_play_with_it.why: The sources describe the tambourine as a percussion instrument that is tapped, hit, or shaken to make music.

how_it_makes_sound.why: The sources say it is played by tapping, hitting, or shaking it, so it makes sound when struck.
